title: I Will Survive: Predicting Business Failures from Customer Ratings
authors: Christof Naumzik; Stefan Feuerriegel; Markus Weinmann
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Prediction of restaurant failures from online ratings with variable-duration hidden Markov models (Stan) against machine-learning benchmarks.
design_notes: Code/0_preprocessing.R, 1_processing.R, 2_train_stan_models.R (rstan::sampling of VD-HMM/HMM), 3_analysis.R (out-of-sample prediction, benchmarks). The regression inventory for this package contains only binary noise from .Rdata files.
data_files_note: README: processed and model-ready data shipped; raw data not included because of size.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
